annotations.text:
SnapTask — full product map    ·    style: vibrant & friendly, violet accent

BUILD FOR SUNDAY (working):   Login   ·   Sign up   ·   My Dashboard   ·   Task Board   ·   Task Detail
PHASE 2 (designed now, built after):   Team Chat   ·   Team Analytics (admin, with forecasting)   ·   Inbox / alerts   ·   Email & reminder settings

App shell on every screen: 260px sidebar (nav + workspaces + chat channels + admin section) and a 64px top bar.

CORE  —  the Sunday target
My Dashboard = your numbers, weekly chart, sprint ring, streak, activity feed.
Task Board = click the status pill on a card to move it (dropdown shown open, no drag).
Task Detail = a slide-over panel over the board.

PHASE 2  —  designed now, built after Sunday
Chat: channels + @mentions + link a task into a message.
Team Analytics (admin only): per-member On track / At risk / Behind, workload balance, and a burndown forecast ("finishes ~2 days late").
Inbox: every alert type in one place.  Settings: which emails go out + reminder timing.
